scientific_integrity: All claims concern mathematical consequences proved in RESULT.md; computational checks and their limitations are specified in VERIFICATION.md. A potential unindexed equivalent vertex-sum theorem is retained as an originality risk.
scientific_limitations: The classification requires a connected simple block graph with at least two vertices. It does not cover arbitrary chordal graphs, and the canonical equivariant homology statement applies only in degrees at least two. The all-parameter proof is conceptual; finite mod-two computations are corroborative, not a proof of torsion-freeness or homotopy type.
title: Blockwise sphere bouquets in neighborhood complexes of block graphs
